connect.title: Connect to car
connect.subtitle: Pick the adapter port and start a diagnostic session.

scan.title: Scan
scan.subtitle: Read stored and pending faults plus readiness monitors.
scan.notConnectedBody: Open the Connect page, choose the COM port and start a session. The scan then reads stored, pending and permanent codes, readiness monitors, the VIN, freeze frames and live PIDs.

live.title: Live Data
live.subtitle: Real-time engine sensors and live telemetry.
live.notConnectedBody: Open the Connect page and establish a connection to start live data streaming.

history.title: History

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, appearance and app information.
settings.privacyBody: This application operates offline-first. Internet access is used exclusively to check for updates and operational status via GitHub. Zero personal information, vehicle VINs, or diagnostic scan results are ever transmitted to any external server.
settings.safetyBody: This app is a diagnostic tool. Clearing codes does not fix the fault; it resets readiness monitors and the freeze frame.

connection.title: Adapter
connection.noPorts: No COM port found. Plug in the adapter, then refresh.
connection.demoDescription: Run the full diagnostic experience (connect, select vehicle, scan, inspect DTC explanations, and execute safe clear flow) with virtual demo data.
connection.portsUnavailableInPreview: Serial ports unavailable in preview mode
connection.realPortsDisabledInPreview: Real serial connection is disabled in browser preview mode
connection.realPortsDisabledNotice: Real serial adapters cannot connect in browser preview mode. Use Demo Experience above.
connection.plugInStep1: Plug the ELM327 adapter into the vehicle OBD-II port (usually under the dashboard).
connection.plugInStep2: Turn vehicle ignition switch to ON (engine off or running).
connection.plugInStep3: Select the COM port from the list and click 'Connect'.
connection.statusIdle: Not connected. Pick a port and press Connect.
connection.statusConnecting: Initialising the adapter and checking the engine ECU…
connection.ecuMissingBody: The adapter works but the engine ECU did not answer. Make sure the ignition is ON and the adapter is fully seated.
connection.cloneBody: Version {{version}} is common on cloned ELM327 adapters. Reading may work, but some commands or older protocols can fail.
connection.limitedBody: The adapter did not accept some initialisation commands; the app will rely on basic commands only.

scan.clearNoCodes: There are no stored or pending codes to clear.
scan.overallHealthyBody: Engine and emissions codes only. Other systems such as ABS, airbags, and transmission are not scanned. The absence of fault codes does not prove the overall vehicle condition is good.
scan.overallWarningBody: Pending trouble codes detected. The check-engine lamp may still be off, but these faults require follow-up.
scan.overallFaultBody: Stored fault codes detected or Check Engine Light is illuminated.
scan.scanNotesNotice: Adapter and protocol notes (these do not indicate vehicle trouble codes).
scan.demoNotice: Demo mode active: Running against a virtual in-memory adapter. No real vehicle or hardware is connected.
scan.vinNotApplicable: Check digit not checked: position 9 is a letter, not a digit/X (many non-North-American VINs do not use the check digit).
scan.vinInvalid: Check digit mismatch: position 9 is a digit/X, so the ISO 3779 check applies.

warnings.pidsUnavailable: The ECU did not report its supported PIDs; only the codes and VIN were read.
warnings.pidNoData: PID {{pid}} is listed as supported but returned no data.
warnings.modeUnsupported: Mode {{mode}} is not supported by this ECU.
warnings.vinUnavailable: The ECU did not report a VIN.
warnings.vinInvalid: The VIN check digit does not match.
warnings.freezeFrameUnavailable: The ECU did not provide a freeze frame.
warnings.dtcCountMismatch: MIL status reported stored codes: {{reported}}; received: {{received}}.
warnings.headersUnavailable: The adapter did not enable response headers, so answers from different ECUs cannot be told apart.

scan.clearConfirmBody: The app saves a full backup in SQLite first, then sends the clear command (Mode 04). Notice: Clearing codes does NOT fix the physical fault, and resets readiness monitors and freeze frames.
scan.engineRunningWarning: The engine appears to be running (RPM above zero). Switching the engine off before clearing is safer. You can still continue.

clearOutcomes.codes_returned: codes_returned — the verification scan found codes again
clearOutcomes.no_codes_returned: no_codes_returned — the verification scan found no stored or pending codes
clearOutcomes.verification_failed: verification_failed — the ECU accepted the clear, but the verification scan failed

scan.clearOutcomeNote: A clean re-scan right after clearing does not prove the fault is repaired. Many codes return only after driving, so re-check after a few drive cycles.
scan.verificationFailed: The ECU accepted the clear, but the verification scan failed. Run a new scan when the connection recovers.
scan.dtcNoDescription: No description yet for this code. Check the vehicle's service manual.
scan.storageUnavailable: The local database is unavailable. You can still scan, but clearing codes, saved vehicles and code explanations are disabled.

errors.clearFailed: The clear flow could not finish. The codes may or may not have been cleared; run a new scan to check.
errors.busy: Another diagnostic operation is still running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.refused: The clear was refused. Nothing was backed up or cleared.
errors.backupFailed: The backup could not be saved, so nothing was cleared.
errors.malformed: The ECU sent an answer the app could not decode.
errors.storageUnavailable: The local database is unavailable, so the backup could not be saved and nothing was cleared.

errors.timeout: The adapter did not answer in time. Check the cable, make sure the ignition is ON, then retry.
errors.no-data: The adapter is connected but the engine ECU returned no data (NO DATA).
errors.unable-to-connect: Could not reach the car's protocol (UNABLE TO CONNECT). Check the adapter is fully seated and the ignition is ON.
errors.bus-init-error: Bus initialisation failed (BUS INIT ERROR). The adapter may not support this car's protocol.
errors.can-error: CAN bus error. Check the connection and retry.
errors.buffer-full: Adapter buffer overflow (BUFFER FULL). Reconnect and try again.
errors.unknown-command: The adapter rejected this command. It may be a clone or incompatible.
errors.adapter-error: The adapter reported an internal error (ERROR). Unplug and reconnect it.
errors.empty-response: The adapter returned an empty response.
errors.transport: Writing to the serial port failed.
errors.open-failed: Could not open the COM port. Another app may be using it.
errors.disconnected: The adapter disconnected. Reconnect it, then connect again.
errors.ports-unavailable: Could not read the COM port list.
errors.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while connecting.

nrc.generalReject: The ECU rejected the request (general rejection).
nrc.serviceNotSupported: This service is not supported by the ECU.
nrc.subFunctionNotSupported: The ECU does not support this sub-function or data format.
nrc.incorrectLength: The request length or format is not accepted by the ECU.
nrc.busy: The ECU is busy. Wait a moment and retry.
nrc.conditionsNotCorrect: The ECU refused because the conditions are not correct (for example the engine state or ignition position).
nrc.requestOutOfRange: The request is outside the range supported by the ECU.
nrc.securityDenied: The ECU refused the request for security reasons.
nrc.responsePending: The ECU is still processing the request. Wait and retry.
nrc.serviceNotSupportedInSession: The service is not supported in the current session.
nrc.unknown: The ECU rejected the request with code {{nrc}}.

live.title: Live Data
live.fuelTrimNormalHint: Total trim is within ±10%, which reflects healthy closed-loop air/fuel ratio management.
live.fuelTrimHighPositiveTitle: High Positive Fuel Trim (+10% or higher)
live.fuelTrimHighPositiveHint: The ECU is adding extra fuel because it senses a lean condition. Common causes: vacuum leak, unmetered air after the MAF, low fuel pressure, or dirty fuel injectors. (Informational only — check with physical inspection).
live.fuelTrimHighNegativeTitle: High Negative Fuel Trim (-10% or lower)
live.fuelTrimHighNegativeHint: The ECU is cutting fuel because it senses a rich condition. Common causes: leaking fuel injector, stuck EVAP purge valve, faulty fuel pressure regulator, or restricted air intake. (Informational only — check with physical inspection).
live.o2Subtitle: Monitor sensor voltage switching and catalyst efficiency
live.o2HintUpstreamSluggish: The upstream sensor should actively switch between ~0.1V and ~0.9V in closed loop. A flatline or sluggish response may indicate a contaminated, unheated, or failing sensor, or open-loop running.
live.o2HintDownstreamOscillating: The downstream sensor should remain relatively steady around 0.6V–0.8V. Rapid switching matching the upstream sensor suggests the catalytic converter is no longer storing oxygen efficiently.
live.o2HintNormalTitle: Oxygen Sensors Operating Within Normal Range
live.o2HintNormal: Sensor activity reflects normal closed-loop air-fuel feedback and catalytic converter operation.

prePurchase.title: Pre-Purchase Inspection
prePurchase.subtitle: Analysis of readiness monitors and DTC clearing counters
prePurchase.modeNormalDesc: Full scan of engine faults, readiness, freeze frames, and live sensors.
prePurchase.modePrePurchaseDesc: Adds suspicious code clearing heuristics, reset counters, and permanent DTC analysis.

none.headline: No indicators of recent code clearing
none.body: Readiness monitors are complete and drive history counters indicate normal driving cycles since any previous reset. No indicators found does not prove that codes were not cleared. A seller can drive enough distance after clearing.

some.headline: Some indicators consistent with recent reset
some.body: One or more readiness monitors or drive counters indicate limited driving since codes or battery were reset.

several.headline: Several indicators suggest codes may have been cleared recently
several.body: Multiple readiness monitors are incomplete, distance/warmups since clearing are low, or permanent codes remain. Wording note: repairs or battery disconnect also reset these.

prePurchase.limitationsNotice: Heuristic evaluation only: Battery disconnection, ECU resets, or component repairs also reset readiness monitors and counters. Values 0xFF (255 warm-ups) and 0xFFFF (65,535 km/min) mean counter at maximum or unavailable and are not treated as reassuring evidence. No indicators found does not prove that codes were not cleared. A seller can drive enough distance after clearing.

explanations.monitorsManyIncomplete: Multiple emission monitors are incomplete, which is typical immediately after clearing codes or battery disconnection.
explanations.monitorsSomeIncomplete: Some emission monitors have not finished running their diagnostic drive cycle.
explanations.monitorsComplete: All supported emission readiness monitors have completed their self-tests.
explanations.distanceVeryLow: Vehicle has traveled under 25 km since codes were cleared, indicating insufficient drive cycle testing.
explanations.distanceLow: Vehicle has traveled under 80 km since codes were cleared.
explanations.distanceAdequate: Vehicle has traveled sufficient distance (>80 km) since last code clear.
explanations.warmupsVeryLow: Fewer than 3 engine warm-up cycles recorded since last code clear.
explanations.warmupsLow: Fewer than 10 engine warm-up cycles recorded since last code clear.
explanations.warmupsAdequate: Normal number of warm-up cycles (10+) recorded since last code clear.
explanations.counterAtMaxOrUnavailable: Counter at maximum or unavailable (0xFF / 0xFFFF); not counted as reassuring evidence.
explanations.permanentPresent: Permanent trouble codes (Mode 0A) were detected. These survive standard clearing until the ECU verifies the fix.
explanations.milHistoryZero: Warning light (MIL) distance and time counters are zero.
explanations.milHistoryActive: Vehicle has recorded driving distance or time with the warning light (MIL) illuminated.
explanations.milHistoryLong: Warning light (MIL) has been on for a long time (high or saturated 0xFFFF distance/time with MIL on).
explanations.pidUnavailable: Parameter not reported by this engine ECU.

report.title: Vehicle Diagnostic Report
report.disclaimerBody: This report is for informational diagnostics only and covers engine and emissions systems. Systems such as ABS, airbags, transmission, body electronics, and chassis components are not included. Clearing trouble codes does not repair underlying mechanical or electrical faults, and resets readiness monitors. Absence of fault codes does not guarantee overall mechanical roadworthiness.
report.mechanicDisclaimer: This is an indication only and not a substitute for an inspection by a qualified mechanic.
report.versionFooter: OBD Diagnose v{{version}} · Offline Diagnostic Tool

history.deleteConfirmBody: This scan session and its results will be removed from local history.
history.diffCodesResolvedDesc: Codes present in earlier scan that did not appear in later scan
history.diffCodesNewDesc: Codes that were not present in earlier scan and appeared in later scan
history.selectTwoNotice: Please select exactly two scans to compare.
